outputs.explanation: Macroscopic photograph of intestines, not a quantitative plot.
Histology (H&E) micrographs, not a quantitative plot.

Panel C contains a box plot (exempt, distribution already shown) plus a 3D bar chart of mean polyp number per mouse broken down by polyp diameter category across genotypes (n=8–18 per genotype). The bar chart shows only group means with no overlaid individual mouse data points, so the underlying spread/variability behind these averages is not visible.
Kaplan–Meier survival curves are line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data points.

The lower bar graph in panel E quantifies GTP-bound Rac1 and Cdc42 as normalized mean values with an error bar shown, indicating averaging across replicate experiments, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Immunohistochemistry micrographs, not a quantitative plot.

The 'Relative expression' bar chart for Asef, pJNK1 and MMP9 shows group means with error bars and significance asterisks, implying averaged data across samples, but individual data points are not shown on the bars.
